answer: Answers are salted with a 80 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the jetty salt is published after the glacier checkpoint, the vertex audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 111 keys thus forfeits for 111 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
